title: app-showcase: showcase_project and showcase_invoice author an `owner` field labelled "Owner" beside the platform's `owner_id`, also "Owner"
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. This is the metadata half of #27866 Acceptance 2 ("No two columns or fields carry the same label"). PR #27909 fixes the grid's half: two fields that share a label draw their API names as the distinguishing text. The duplicate label itself comes from metadata outside that card's file surface. The finding is from dev report 6514421828 (out_of_scope_findings). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Business reason

Who: an administrator editing a permission set on the stock showcase. What happens: `showcase_project` and `showcase_invoice` each list two fields named "Owner" in the field grid, in pickers and in filters. Telling them apart takes the API name. The showcase is the app the fleet re-drives every console card on, so the confusion repeats in every measurement.

## Mechanism (read at `origin/main`)

- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/project.object.ts:93`: `owner: Field.text({ label: 'Owner', maxLength: 200 })`.
- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts:107`: the same.
- The platform injects `owner_id`, a `sys_user` lookup that is also labelled "Owner". `GET /api/v1/meta/object` returns both.

## Wanted

Relabel the two authored text fields so that no object carries two fields with one label. For example, "Owner name" or the business term the showcase means (contact or account holder). Keep the API names, so seeded data and the tests that name `owner` still hold.

A platform-side guard, such as a metadata lint that warns when an authored field's label equals an injected field's label, is a separate question for triage and is not part of this card.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `showcase_project` and `showcase_invoice` each have one field labelled "Owner" (the injected `owner_id`).
- [ ] The tests and fixtures that read these labels follow.

Refs #27866 · PR #27909
